description: Trastuzumab in combination with paclitaxel is recommended as an option for people with tumours expressing human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) scored at levels of 3 or more who have not received chemotherapy for metastatic breast cancer and in whom anthracycline treatment is inappropriate. Trastuzumab monotherapy is recommended as an option for people with tumours expressing HER2 scored at levels of 3 or more who have received at least 2 chemotherapy regimens for metastatic breast cancer.
